problems: Elenchus cut prints no column numbers (body-only throughout); the closing Ordo supplies a second reading, quoted per entry.
Oratio in Alexium Comnenum is in the Ordo and the body (col 287) but not in the Elenchus cut; added as an extra entry after the Testimonium.

Ordo letter lists (Epistolae XX, LXXV, XXXV) are heavily garbled (digits $/5/3, 1/4/7); parts are copied as read and are not body-confirmed. Some Ordo lines are missing in the OCR, so a part list may be short.
Institutio regia: the Ordo lists chapter-level columns; not copied (only top-level pieces are parts per the brief). Both Pars are separate entries because the Elenchus lists them separately.
Vita S. Clementis: Ordo and Elenchus put it with the Appendix at col 1191; the Greek/Latin Vita title is on leaf 1193|1194 by the OCR running head.
Leaf numbers for Historia martyrii (151), Oratio in Praesentationem (129; Ordo 150), and Institutio regia (251) rest on running heads and inference.
Greek flag set from the heads seen (variae lectiones, prooemium, etc. are bilingual); not checked page by page.
